posts.name: Inbox Zero
posts.tagline: Open-source Superhuman alternative
posts.description: Inbox Zero Mail is an open-source email client for Gmail and Outlook. Fast, keyboard-first, and free to use, on web, Mac, Windows and iPhone, with all your accounts in one inbox. Add AI for $20/mo: every email is sorted, and replies are drafted in your voice before you open them. Comment privately with your team, get Slack alerts, and give the AI context from your tools.

posts.name: MyLens
posts.tagline: 1-1 Live Presentations at Scale with AI.
posts.description: MyLens is AI for live 1-1 presentations at scale. You add your raw sources, say what matters, and invite your audience. MyLens AI gives every person a live, private presentation, answers their questions using your sources, and create new slides and layers in real time during the presentation. Then the AI tells you how each session went, so you can see who’s doing well, who’s stuck, and what to do next.

posts.name: shim-cli
posts.tagline: See what your coding agent sends. Mask what you can.
posts.description: An open-source hook and local proxy for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and VS Code. In Claude Code it masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model reads them, and shim watch shows what a session sent and cost. No account, no telemetry.

posts.name: Tower 18 for Mac
posts.tagline: The most powerful Git client with a better CLI experience
posts.description: Tower 18 for Mac is here! This update is all about improving the Tower experience in the terminal: the Tower Command Line Tool can now take you straight to any view in Tower (History, Blame, the Working Copy, Branches Review, and more) with a single command.

posts.name: MeetPaw
posts.tagline: Instant meetings from your mac menu bar
posts.description: MeetPaw is a lightweight macOS menu-bar app that puts your meetings one click away. Spin up an instant Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams link the moment you need it. The link is created, copied to your clipboard, and ready to share before you've switched windows. No tabs, no digging, no friction.

posts.name: XBOX Nano Controller
posts.tagline: Pocket-sized wireless gamepad with all 18 inputs
posts.description: Take play to more places with the XBOX Nano Controller. Fit more play in your everyday in a smaller form factor. Connect via Bluetooth & play across devices.

posts.name: 3AM Super Intelligence
posts.tagline: Production incidents: investigated, proven, fixed
posts.description: Meet 3AM, the AI on-call engineer for systems you can’t rewrite. It finds the root cause, rehearses the fix, and resolves the incident with one tap in Slack, all from inside your network.

posts.name: Tomo for ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Ask anything. Then play it, Duolingo-style.
posts.description: Ask ChatGPT for a Tomo course on black holes and a game drops into the chat. Quick questions, hearts on the line. Any topic, even the chat you’re in. Pick your teacher, from The Professor to The Pirate. Add Tomo from Plugins in ChatGPT. No sign-up to start.

posts.name: PasteKit
posts.tagline: Format JSON, YAML & SQL privately
posts.description: Paste JSON, YAML, XML, SQL, CSV or code and get formatted, validated output instantly. 58 formats, 48 converters and JSON tools (diff, schema, repair, jq). Everything runs in your browser, enforced by a strict CSP, so nothing you paste leaves your machine.

posts.name: Openbroca
posts.tagline: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
posts.description: Openbroca is a native Swift AI dictation app for Mac, with a ~6.5 MB download. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and get clean text right where you're typing. It removes fillers and repetition while keeping your meaning and tone, with no prompt tweaking. Includes a personal dictionary that learns from corrections, Typeless dictionary import, and translation into 28 languages. All features are free to try.

posts.name: Gravity Notes
posts.tagline: One list of notes, for you and your AI agents
posts.description: Gravity is a notes app built on Andrej Karpathy's append-and-review note. Everything goes into one list, newest at the top. Old notes sink, and a swipe brings one back. You pay once, and your notes stay on your devices. New since the last launch: live Markdown, checklists, full exports, and a gravity CLI on the Mac that lets Claude Code, Codex or your own scripts read and write your notes. For iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android.

posts.name: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse
posts.tagline: Amazon's personal AI memory, now on your wrist or phone
posts.description: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse are Amazon's new personal AI devices that help you remember what matters. Frontier is a wearable for your wrist or clothing, while Eclipse attaches magnetically to your phone. Both capture conversations and turn them into useful summaries, reminders, and follow-ups without retaining audio recordings. With Alexa+ integration, your personal AI memory can help you recall important details and act on them later.

posts.name: Vampire Crawlers™
posts.tagline: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
posts.description: From the somehow triple-BAFTA‑winning creators of Vampire Survivors, Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors turns the snowballing thrill of Survivors into a hyper turn‑based, card‑driven BLOBBER with rogue-lite elements. Build busted decks, explore familiar dungeons from a new perspective, and unleash world‑ending combos. Either take your time and be tactical, or play turns as fast as you humanly can: The outcome is always accurate, we call it hyper for a reason!

posts.name: Popcraft
posts.tagline: Generate video, images & audio from any AI agent
posts.description: Paste one URL into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code and your agent can plan, cost-preview and generate video, images, music and SFX with Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana Pro and 20+ more. OAuth sign-in, no API key. 100 free credits.

posts.name: Latch
posts.tagline: The app blocker you unlock by walking to your key
posts.description: Latch locks distracting apps until you scan your key, and the key lives where you have to walk: an NFC sticker on the fridge, a printed QR code, or a number of steps. No account, no ads, no analytics. iPhone and Android; Pro is $9.99 once.

posts.name: SpeechFast
posts.tagline: Local Whisper for Mac
posts.description: Hold fn and talk. SpeechFast types clean text at your cursor, in any app. Everything runs on your Mac. The speech model is downloaded once; after that, no audio and no text ever leaves your machine. It works offline, on a plane, behind a locked-down corporate network. Dictate in Mail, Slack, Notion, your code editor, anywhere you can type Filler words and false starts cleaned up with Apple Intelligence Your own vocabulary for names and jargon History of your recent dictations, stored locally

posts.name: Krea 3
posts.tagline: Krea's AI image model: 2K edits in under 8 seconds
posts.description: Krea 3 is a fast AI image editing model built for creators and production teams. Edit images in under 8 seconds at native 2K resolution for just $0.06 per image. Change backgrounds, objects, materials, or lighting while preserving the details you want to keep. Use up to 6 reference images to maintain consistent products, characters, and styles across an entire campaign. Less waiting, fewer unwanted changes, and more room to experiment.

posts.name: Zalcro
posts.tagline: The pre-build planning tool for vibe coders and AI builders
posts.description: Zalcro is the pre-build planning tool for AI app builders. Jumping straight into prompting usually leads to a doom loop where the AI loses context and breaks your app. Zalcro solves this by mapping out your architecture before you begin. It generates a build-ready plan so your AI knows exactly what to do. Whether you use Lovable, Replit, Cursor, or Claude Code, Zalcro gives you step-by-step prompts you paste directly or connect via MCP. Build better. Plan before you prompt,

posts.name: Startories
posts.tagline: The AI engine that finds your next B2B customers
posts.description: Startories is an AI engine that catches B2B buyers while they're actively looking for solutions. It monitors Reddit, X, Product Hunt, directories and search for fresh buying signals, qualifies each company against your ICP, finds the decision-maker, verifies their email and starts personalized outreach. Instead of waiting for inbound leads to reach your website, Startories finds the demand already happening across the web.

posts.name: Ellie — Elephant in the Room
posts.tagline: A deaf baby elephant who fingerspells any word in ASL
posts.description: Ellie is a deaf baby elephant who signs with her trunk. Give her any word and she'll fingerspell it for you — one letter at a time, with big, friendly captions. Choose your manual alphabet: ASL, Libras, or BSL (her sister Tunk helps with BSL's two hands). Ellie is a free widget that lives at ellie.mrbray.com and embeds on any website with one line of code. No audio, no account — just a joyful deaf character putting herself at the heart of the story.

posts.name: Evane
posts.tagline: Every Event Cognitively Convened
posts.description: Evane is an AI agent designed for government-enterprise collaboration and complex, multi-stakeholder programs, where alignment, accountability and speed determine outcomes. It replaces fragmented communication with a unified data foundation, automates repetitive work, and gives leaders real-time tracking and early bottleneck alerts.

posts.name: Pairon
posts.tagline: Your team and AI coding agents, in one shared conversation
posts.description: AI agents move fast; context gets lost between chats. Pairon brings your team and locally running coding agents into a shared conversation. Teammates can add constraints mid-task, run tasks in parallel, hand work across computers, and review changes together. A continuation brief and project memory carry decisions forward. Computer owners control folder access. Use Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode with your own agent accounts. Following beta testing with 500+ people, we've launched publicly.

posts.name: Syllaby Mobile App
posts.tagline: Save Up to 70% Of Your Content-Creation Time on the Go
posts.description: Syllaby is your all-in-one AI studio for viral video creation. Instantly turn ideas into faceless or cinematic content with trending topics, ready-to-film scripts, and studio-quality visuals. From planning to publishing, Syllaby streamlines every step—so your content stays consistent, professional, and unmistakably yours.

posts.name: TypeKey
posts.tagline: AI writing tools and a keyboard for your iPhone
posts.description: Paste your text, tap a tool, copy the result: humanize AI text, paraphrase, fix grammar, summarize, or write a cover letter or an email. No keyboard setup needed. Or turn on the TypeKey keyboard to reply, translate and fix spelling in your other apps.

posts.name: NakkoBroker
posts.tagline: Zero-brokerage rental discovery across Indian tech hubs
posts.description: NakkoBroker eliminates broker commissions in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune & Vizag. Discover flats directly on an interactive map, schedule visits, chat with verified owners, and build a portable Good Renter reputation badge.

posts.name: The Soapbox Email
posts.tagline: What will you say to 1 million people?
posts.description: Every morning, one subscriber is picked at random to write a single email. It goes to the whole list. Tomorrow, it could be you. What happens if you give one random person an enormous platform to use their voice?

posts.name: Buildhorn: CI/CD Alerts
posts.tagline: Know the instant your build breaks
posts.description: Buildhorn watches your CI pipelines and notifies you the moment a build fails, right on your Apple device. Get push notifications with custom sounds for failures and turn your home screen into a build-status dashboard.

posts.name: MySiteGPT Assistant
posts.tagline: Create an AI assistant from your website content
posts.description: Turn your website content into an AI assistant that answers your visitor questions using your information. Help visitors find information find answers faster and support your business with automated conversations.

posts.name: Charter
posts.tagline: Open-source Composio alternative for AI agents
posts.description: A Python library that turns any API into an agent tool you own. No third-party server, no per-call pricing, no rate limits on top. Your rules decide what the agent sees and sends, and a call that breaks one never reaches the API.

posts.name: Viewlify
posts.tagline: See exactly why any TikTok blows up, in seconds
posts.description: Paste any TikTok @handle and see which videos really broke out. Viewlify scores every video by its multiple: how many times it beat the creator's own usual views. Then it shows the hooks, formats and posting patterns behind each breakout, plus an AI plan for what to post next. Also free: a daily trending page (videos, hashtags, sounds by niche) and 20+ creator tools with no signup.

posts.name: What the Fetch
posts.tagline: A network agent in your browser
posts.description: What the Fetch is a network agent in your browser for debugging web apps. Record requests and console output, ask AI what failed, and follow citations to the evidence. Export HAR, cURL and recordings. Try limited included AI or connect your own provider.

posts.name: AudioEnhancerMAX
posts.tagline: Local audio editing with AI governance built in
posts.description: Clean, transcribe and edit audio on your Mac with AI governance built into the workflow. Review and approve proposed speech edits, undo decisions and preserve the original recording. Processing reports and Project Capsules document settings, transformations and file integrity. Core processing runs locally, with separate controls for optional external services and trusted-LAN processing. Open source for podcasters, interviewers and creators who need control and traceability.

posts.name: HealthPilot
posts.tagline: Turn Apple Health data into clear, personalized guidance.
posts.description: HealthPilot transforms your raw Apple Health metrics into actionable daily insights. Designed with a privacy-first, on-device architecture, all your personal health data is processed entirely on your phone—never sent to external servers. Track trends, understand key health patterns, and receive clear guidance to optimize your daily wellbeing without compromising your privacy.

posts.name: MIRA Stories
posts.tagline: The AI online photo book: photos in, story out
posts.description: MIRA turns a folder of trip, wedding or family photos into a magazine-style story in about a minute. It picks the best shots, builds chapters and writes the captions. Share one link that opens on any phone, or keep it as a print-ready PDF.

posts.name: AutoAlert: UPI Sound Alert
posts.tagline: Hear every UPI payment out loud in English, Hindi or Telugu
posts.description: AutoAlert turns any Android phone into a UPI sound box. It reads payment notifications from PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM and more, and announces each credit aloud in English, Hindi or Telugu. Choose which apps trigger alerts; everything else stays silent. It runs fully on-device with no servers, so payment data never leaves the phone. Optional daily backup goes to your own Google Drive. Built for shopkeepers, vendors and freelancers who can't keep checking the screen.

posts.name: PM Podcast Summaries by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: The best PM and AI podcasts, as 10-minute structured notes
posts.description: Structured notes from 135 episodes of the top product management and AI podcasts, including Lenny's Podcast, How I AI and The AI Daily Brief. Each summary covers the big idea, key insights, mental models and frameworks, with the original audio player built in. New episodes added every week. Free.

posts.name: SuperQuill
posts.tagline: Private, fast ai voice dictation for Mac
posts.description: SuperQuill is private, fast AI dictation for Mac that shows a live transcript as you speak. Ramble turns think-out-loud brain-dumps into concise prompts that coding agents like Cursor can act on. Your voice never leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Aurora Agentic Terminal
posts.tagline: Your terminal needs to think smarter.
posts.description: Aurora - a hardware-accelerated, AI-native developer terminal. GPU-rendered blocks, multi-provider AI routing, and a local agent sidecar.

posts.name: VoicedByMe
posts.tagline: Any text, voiced by you: AI agents, audiobooks, messages
posts.description: VoicedByMe reads any text aloud in your own cloned voice, made from a 20-second recording, or in one of 35 ready-made voices, from natural narrators to a pirate. It all runs on your computer and nothing is uploaded. AI agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can speak replies and ask permission out loud. Read selected text in any app with a shortcut, read text off the screen, turn ebooks into audiobooks or make voice clips for WhatsApp slack or teams.

posts.name: DigitalOcean Managed Agents
posts.tagline: Run AI agents in the cloud with managed sessions and tools
posts.description: DigitalOcean Managed Agents runs AI agents in the cloud. Harness Runtime gives each session its own Firecracker microVM that can pause, resume and fork, and runs Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Hermes, LangGraph, CrewAI or any container. Action Gateway gives agents 16,000+ tools through one MCP endpoint, with credentials kept from the model and approvals for risky actions. Public Preview, from $5 trial.

posts.name: Wallistic- 4K Dark & Aesthetic wallpaper
posts.tagline: Curated 4K high quality Dark/Amoled and Aesthetic wallpapers
posts.description: Wallistic is a modern Android Wallpaper app, designed especially for people who want high quality clean images to personalize their phones Discover High quality 4K Dark, Amoled as well as soft Aesthetic wallpapers in normal and celebrative themes. Scroll through custom collection including pastel arts, line arts as well as anime arts. It contains different sections (Dark and Aesthetic) for different moods. Built with smooth native UI in KMP for effortless scrolling and swiping through carousels.

posts.name: PrintxPDF
posts.tagline: Clean web printing and privacy-first PDF tools
posts.description: PrintxPDF brings together a Chrome extension for clean web printing and 44 PDF and file tools. Most PDF actions run in your browser. Eight conversion and security workflows upload files to our Worker. The PDF editor adds text, shapes, signatures, and comments as overlays instead of rewriting original PDF text. Free tools need no account.

posts.name: GmailClass - Gmail Email Classifier
posts.tagline: GmailClass adds categorized labels to emails in your inbox
posts.description: Your inbox, labeled in your own words! GmailClass uses Jev AI to match emails to categories you describe, then adds colorful labels right inside Gmail. Spot invoices, travel updates, newsletters, or whatever matters to you at a glance! Choose your colors, fine-tune matching conditions, and let one email fit multiple categories. Your inbox stays yours: GmailClass doesn't move, archive, or delete your mail. Completely free to use, but requires a TypeSafe API key you need to set up.

posts.name: JetKreate
posts.tagline: The creator platform for everyone with an idea
posts.description: Your whole creative process in one place. JetKreate helps you find the idea, write it, make it and share it: images, video, audio and scripts, plus a creator profile to show your work. Start with a sentence, a photo or a trend.

posts.name: DeskPet
posts.tagline: A native macOS app: an orange cat that lives on your Mac
posts.description: DeskPet is a cute virtual pet that lives on your Mac desktop and helps you stay productive. Run Pomodoro-style focus sessions, get gentle reminders to drink water, stretch and rest your eyes, and keep track of tasks and notes. Chat with your pet by typing or voice, like “Start a 25-minute focus session” or “Add buy groceries to my tasks.” Private by default: it only reads your data if you allow it. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later.

posts.name: KelpShot
posts.tagline: Screenshots that say what you mean.
posts.description: KelpShot is a fast, private screenshot tool for macOS: capture, annotate, redact, recognize text, and share in seconds. One-time purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: GlowBack
posts.tagline: Track GLP-1 doses, symptoms, meals, and progress

Built for personal tracking and organization.

posts.name: ChannelHunt
posts.tagline: Product Hunt for YouTube channels
posts.description: Channel Hunt is a discovery platform for YouTube channels. Creators submit their channel for free, the community upvotes the best ones, and every channel gets its launch day. Browse community-voted channels across Tech, Finance, Gaming, Education and more, and find what YouTube's algorithm misses.

posts.name: Melodic Recorder
posts.tagline: Record, organize, edit, and export audio in one place
posts.description: Keep a quick recording useful after the moment passes. Capture song ideas, rehearsals, interviews or demos; review the waveform; trim and edit audio; and add effects without leaving the browser. Tag recordings so they stay easy to find, sync them to the cloud, and export the result for your next step. Melodic Recorder is built for musicians and creators who want capture and organization together. Free features with optional paid upgrades. Also available on Android.

posts.name: GameBrain for WordPress
posts.tagline: Game review scores, info cards & prices for WordPress
posts.description: GameBrain adds four video game blocks to WordPress: a game info card, a review summary with GameBrain, critic and user scores plus what players like and dislike, a row of similar games, and a where-to-buy price list. The data comes from GameBrain's database of 800,000+ games. Blocks render on your server as HTML with schema.org markup, are cached on your site and use your theme's fonts and colors. You connect with one click and no API key. Free.

posts.name: Flich | motion graphics with AI
posts.tagline: Motion graphics advertisements with AI model of your choice.
posts.description: Running a business or a SaaS? You need motion graphics: launch videos, explainers, ads. Agencies charge $1,000+ and take weeks. Flich makes them in minutes, for under $1. Just describe your video, pick your AI model, and get a polished 1080p video with animation and sound, ready to post. Want a change? Just ask. We built Flich because great marketing videos shouldn’t be a luxury. Now they’re for everyone ♥ Your first video is free.

posts.name: WalkThen
posts.tagline: Turn your steps into screen time for distracting apps
posts.description: WalkThen locks the apps you open on autopilot and unlocks them with steps. Pick an app, walk, and every 500 verified iPhone steps earns 10 minutes of access. Emergency unlock is always available in Settings. Free: 1 app, 5/10-min sessions. Pro: multiple apps, categories & websites, custom rules, access hours.

Producer Memory keep your voice, audience and creative direction in context, while your Episode Library keeps your work organized. Go from “What should I talk about?” to a clear plan without writing a separate prompt for every piece.

posts.name: GMB Pin Fixer
posts.tagline: Fix wrong Google Business pins without suspensions
posts.description: Did Google drop your storefront pin blocks away? GMB Pin Fixer extracts exact rooftop GPS coordinates from WhatsApp, Maps, or your live device and auto-snaps your pin inside Google Business Profile in 1 click without triggering algorithmic suspensions.

posts.description: Most AI finance tools return one answer. WealthSieve runs a desk: analysts, a bull-versus-bear debate and a risk review across stocks, funds, ETFs, bonds and more. You get the pros, cons and risks. You decide.

The map, the outline and the documents are always one thing, so nothing gets out of sync.

posts.name: Blindshot
posts.tagline: Bocce on a world map — guess cities, knock rivals away
posts.description: Bocce on a world map. Nobody sees the target: throw stones where you think the city is, knock your rivals away, then the map reveals who really knew. Daily challenge, duels and online rooms.

posts.name: Celeris Realtime
posts.tagline: Realtime Infrastructure for Builders
posts.description: Celeris delivers live messages between browsers, mobile applications, backends, and services, for chat, order status, and live dashboards.

posts.name: Nox Hall - New Game Mahjong!
posts.tagline: Your browser game hall. New game have arrived, Mahjong!
posts.description: Nox Hall is a free browser game platform, this are our new game launch, Mahjong!. Play against labelled bots, join Quick Play, or invite friends to a private room. Start as a guest, learn the rules in the lobby, and keep your progress when you register. More games are in development and under wraps.

posts.name: ORIN — The Oral Insulin Network
posts.tagline: No needle. No blood. Just protection, release and delivery.
posts.description: ORIN is the project token of the Oral Insulin Network: a neutral evidence network for any oral insulin that works. ERC-20 on Base, paired with wNEWS. No needle. No blood. Just protection, release and delivery.

posts.name: Kuvstudio
posts.tagline: AI-powered product image generator for e-commerce
posts.description: Generate listing-ready product images for Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, TikTok Shop, and ads from one product photo.

posts.name: Amy
posts.tagline: AI tutor with live voice, interactive visuals & quizzes
posts.description: Meet Amy, an AI-powered tutor built to make learning more interactive and personalized. Go beyond simple text explanations with live voice tutoring, interactive whiteboards, visual diagrams, quizzes, and AI-generated learning materials, including presentations, images, and videos. Whether you're preparing for exams or exploring something new, Amy helps you understand concepts through engaging, guided conversations. Currently free during early access.

posts.name: Amy
posts.tagline: AI tutor with live voice, interactive visuals & quizzes
posts.description: Meet Amy, an AI-powered tutor built to make learning more interactive and personalized. Go beyond simple text explanations with live voice tutoring, interactive whiteboards, visual diagrams, quizzes, and AI-generated learning materials, including presentations, images, and videos. Whether you're preparing for exams or exploring something new, Amy helps you understand concepts through engaging, guided conversations. Currently free during early access.

posts.name: Mikaka
posts.tagline: Turn WhatsApp chats into action and customer insights
posts.description: Mikaka answers WhatsApp and Messenger enquiries using your business knowledge, captures next steps, and reveals what customers keep asking for. Built for African businesses. Social starts at $39/month; provider usage charges may apply.

posts.name: Startup Malpractice Quiz
posts.tagline: Find out what's professionally wrong with you.
posts.description: The startup world is full of visionaries, thought leaders, growth hackers, and people who haven't made a sale but somehow have a podcast. Startup Malpractice brings that same energy to a quiz. Find out which corporate or startup stereotype you are, and discover whether you're the problem everyone complains about in Slack. It's satire, not a personality assessment. Please don't put your result on LinkedIn. Unless you're a thought leader. Then you absolutely will.

posts.name: Eternal Aether
posts.tagline: Your characters dont just remember you, they BELONG to you.
posts.description: Eternal Aether is a home for AI story characters who remember you. Every character keeps persistent memories you can view and edit, writes diaries, and grows a bond from Stranger to Eternal Bond. Pricing is printed in plain sight: free to start with 10 shards, no card, 1 shard per reply, shards never expire, no ads, no queues. Meet 88 characters, import the ones you already love, or create your own in 22 art styles. Creators keep 85–90%, and chats and character cards export instantly, any time.

posts.name: why you
posts.tagline: A website you can't sign up for. Someone has to choose you.
posts.description: You can't sign up for why you. Someone has to choose you, with one line about why. You read it, scroll back through every stranger before you, then get 3 notes of your own to pass on. Notes fade after 48 hours if nobody opens them.

posts.name: Shuffleet
posts.tagline: The gym for data engineers: train on real SQL & Spark
posts.description: Practice the data engineering interview questions SQL puzzles don't cover: deduplication, incremental loads, MERGE, SCD2, late data. SQL & PySpark in your browser, graded automatically. Free.

posts.name: DevDrop
posts.tagline: Phone to computer in one scan. No app, nothing uploaded.
posts.description: Move screenshots, recordings, files and text between your phone and computer. Open devdrop.in, scan the QR code, send. Files go straight between the two devices over encrypted WebRTC and never touch our server. No app, no account, free.

posts.name: TrenchHQ
posts.tagline: Your crypto desktop companion for Windows
posts.description: TrenchHQ brings crypto prices, wallet activity, X feeds, websites and apps into customizable Windows overlays and screen-edge panels. Keep what matters visible across your monitors without constantly switching tabs. Free and open source.

posts.name: SeeTheScale
posts.tagline: See how big numbers really are
posts.description: Big numbers are hard to feel. SeeTheScale turns them into graphics you can grasp – stacks of $100 bills, a football field and more. Browse curated comparisons with sources or build your own, by hand or with AI. Free to try, no account needed.

posts.name: Frontel
posts.tagline: AI phone answering with clear call notes for your business
posts.description: Frontel is an AI receptionist for business calls. Add your services, hours and business information, then activate a dedicated phone number. Frontel answers common questions, captures enquiries and appointment requests, and keeps clear call notes in your private inbox.

posts.name: Pathmode
posts.tagline: Review your coding agent's plan before it builds.
posts.description: Coding agents make product decisions while writing code. Pathmode brings those choices to your team before implementation. Review the agent's proposed spec in the browser, answer open questions, request changes, and approve a revision. The spec lives in your repository as intent.md, and pull requests are checked against its recorded decisions. Developers can start free with Preflight, a local readiness check with no account required.

posts.name: Arci
posts.tagline: Instant, private Mac launcher with AI and custom actions
posts.description: Arci is a fast, free launcher for macOS. Press one shortcut to open apps, calculate, convert units and currencies, check time zones, search files, ask AI, set timers, and paste from encrypted clipboard history. AI runs on-device with Apple Intelligence, or bring your own Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or OpenRouter key. Build custom actions in plain JSON, or describe one and let Arci Builder write it. No account, no analytics, no tracking. Your data stays on your Mac.

posts.name: Audesti
posts.tagline: Collect Audio testimonials & reuse use as social content
posts.description: Send a link. Your customer talks for 35 seconds on their phone: no app, no camera. audesti transcribes it, turns the best lines into ready-to-post social cards and a site widget, and shows which ones get played. Works inside Claude via MCP. From $18/mo.

posts.name: GhostCall  — Calls Without Phone Numbers
posts.tagline: Talk without sharing your phone number
posts.description: Make voice calls without exchanging phone numbers, creating an account, or downloading an app. Create a call, share a link, and talk instantly from your browser. Supports one-to-one and group voice calls.

posts.name: Mecrio
posts.tagline: AI marketing operating system for modern advertising
posts.description: Mecrio is an AI-powered marketing operating system that helps businesses and agencies create, optimize, and publish advertising campaigns from a single workspace. Generate ad copy, creatives, audience targeting, and campaign structures with AI, then publish to Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X. Bring your own AI key, automate repetitive marketing tasks, and manage multi-platform advertising without switching between dashboards.

posts.name: AiStager
posts.tagline: AI virtual staging, photo editing & property video tours
posts.description: AiStager helps real estate professionals and property owners turn ordinary property photos into compelling marketing visuals. Virtually stage empty rooms, enhance listing photos, and create AI-powered video tours in one platform. Unlike tools that unnecessarily alter spaces, AiStager focuses on preserving architectural details while delivering realistic results. No design skills or expensive physical staging required. Upload a photo, transform the space, and showcase its potential.

posts.name: Groundbeat
posts.tagline: A real-time pulse of the nation, one poll at a time
posts.description: Groundbeat is a real-time pulse of the nation. Twice a day an AI editorial desk reads the news and drafts neutral polls on everything from Congress to soulmates. Vote in one tap, no signup, then make your case in the comments. Members are the official count.

posts.name: Nodetto
posts.tagline: A drawing tool for humans and AI
posts.description: Draw interfaces, databases and systems on a local macOS canvas, or let AI edit the same Git-friendly JSONL files. A bundled Rust CLI and MCP server support drawing, inspection and SVG/PNG/PDF export. Free, open source, with no Node.js or Bun required.

posts.name: FreeVideoGenerator
posts.tagline: Free AI video generator — text & photos to video
posts.description: Free AI video generator: turn text prompts and photos into video clips with Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Wan and more. Free starter credits, no sign-up friction, no watermark downloads.

posts.name: Launchlane
posts.tagline: Turn business ideas into websites and apps with AI
posts.description: Describe your idea, answer short guided questions, then preview and refine it in one workspace. Launchlane helps you build business websites, internal tools, customer portals and apps without starting from a blank canvas. Check desktop and mobile views before publishing. New accounts can create one personalized website preview without a card. Website plans start at $29/year; apps and software at $49/year. Publishing requires a paid plan.
